note: R1h fixed-design check: the R1d continuous design with the flow solved at h or h/2, each on the thermal meshes h/2 and h/4. Two meshes are not an exact solution; differences between cells are mesh differences, not errors. D_T and -1/2 D_T2 are algebraic shares of each solution. J* uses the single-mesh frozen Psi_0 and C_0 as a common reporting scale only.
